name: Sales
description: Sales orders with line discounts and service lines, confirmation, delivery and Thai tax invoices (VAT 7%, amount in Thai words, Buddhist-era date, PromptPay QR) with due dates; receipts (ใบเสร็จรับเงิน) with partial payment, withholding tax and deposits (มัดจำ); receivables and aging. Cuts stock automatically when Inventory is installed; drafts a sales order from an accepted CRM quotation when CRM is installed.
